leaderboard.title: Season leaderboard
leaderboard.lede: Points from every game played so far this season.
leaderboard.failed: The leaderboard couldn't be loaded. Try again in a moment.
leaderboard.noGames: No game has been played this season yet.

matches.title: Matches
matches.failed: The matches couldn't be loaded. Try again in a moment.
matches.none: No match is planned for this season yet.

match.missing: This season has no match with this number.
match.failed: This match couldn't be loaded. Try again in a moment.

notFound.body: This page doesn't exist, or the organisation behind it is no longer available. Check the address, or start from the home page.
notFound.title: Page not found

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.why: Admins sign in to enter scores and run their organisation. Players sign in to follow their own stats.
signIn.privacy: We only receive your name, email address and profile picture from Google. No password is stored here.
signIn.failed: Signing in didn't work. Try again, with a Google account whose email address is verified.
signIn.noOrganisations: You don't belong to any organisation yet.
signIn.separate: Each organisation keeps its own players, scores and admins. Being an admin in one gives you no access to another.

adminPlayers.title: Players
adminPlayers.lede: Players can be added and edited but never deleted, so past results stay intact. Changing a Riot ID keeps the old one as an alias.
adminPlayers.taken: Another player already has this Riot ID.
adminPlayers.invalid: Check the details: a player needs a Riot ID, and names have at most 100 characters.
adminPlayers.failed: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.

adminScores.title: Enter scores
adminScores.lede: One game at a time. The leaderboard updates when you save.
adminScores.automaticLabel: {{bonus}}, {{name}}: worked out when you check or save
adminScores.carried: Players carried over from match {{match}}, game {{game}}: only the numbers need entering.
adminScores.bonusHelp: Automatic bonuses are worked out when you check them or save; manual ones are ticked by hand.
adminScores.clearAsk: Remove this game’s scores? The match stays, with its date.
adminScores.discard: Leave this game? Its unsaved changes will be lost.
adminScores.saved: Game {{game}} of match {{match}} saved. The leaderboard is up to date.
adminScores.checked: Bonuses checked. They are kept when you save.
adminScores.empty: Pick at least one player before saving.
adminScores.twice: Line {{row}}: this player is already on another line.
adminScores.refused: The scores were refused: check every number, then save again.
adminScores.failed: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.

adminSeasons.title: Seasons
adminSeasons.lede: Each season keeps its own scoring rules, so old results never change.
adminSeasons.name: Name
adminSeasons.tooSmall: Saved games don’t fit: the season already has a later match, or a match with more games.
adminSeasons.invalid: Check the details, then try again.
adminSeasons.failed: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.

problems.name: A season needs a name of at most {{maxName}} characters.
problems.games: A match has 1 to {{maxGames}} games, the fewest no more than the most.
problems.dates: A season can’t end before it starts.

adminScoring.title: Scoring rules
adminScoring.lede: What each stat, each game’s KDA, a win and each bonus are worth in this season. A change applies to every game of the season at once; other seasons never change.
adminScoring.locked: {{season}} is finished, so its rules can’t change. Reopen it on the Seasons screen to change them.
adminScoring.statsHelp: A stat that’s switched off isn’t asked for on the Scores form, and stops counting in every game of the season, even games saved before. Switch Honours on to enter them.
adminScoring.shownOnly: Shown in tables, not added to points
adminScoring.placeOnly: Picks MVP and SVP, not added to points
adminScoring.kdaHelp: Each game’s (kills + assists) ÷ deaths, counting no deaths as one, times this.
adminScoring.bonusesHelp: Bonuses are worked out when a game is saved, and again for the whole season when the rules change. Players tied for the best value all win.

won.TOP_WINNER: Best place on the winning team
won.TOP_LOSER: Best place on the losing team

adminScoring.saved: {{season}}’s rules are saved, and its points follow them.
adminScoring.defaultsConfirm: Replace {{season}}’s rules with the platform defaults? Its other bonuses stay, and its points are worked out again.

problems.stat: {{stat}}: points go from -{{maxPoints}} to {{maxPoints}}, with up to two decimals.
problems.kda: The KDA points go from 0 to {{maxPoints}}, with up to two decimals.
problems.win: The points per win are a whole number from 0 to {{maxPoints}}.
problems.bonus: {{code}}: points are a whole number from 0 to {{maxPoints}}.

adminScoring.invalid: These rules were refused. Check the numbers and try again.
adminScoring.finished: This season is finished: reopen it to change its rules.
adminScoring.failed: That didn’t work. Try again in a moment.

adminMembers.title: Members
adminMembers.lede: Everyone who joined {{org}}. Admins enter scores and run the organisation.
adminMembers.inviteHelp: Admins are invited one by one, with the email of their Google account. The invite only works for that account, once.
adminMembers.badEmail: Type the email of their Google account.
adminMembers.pasteHelp: Paste it in WhatsApp, Discord or a text message. The code is shown only now: lost it? Revoke the invite and make a new one.
adminMembers.message: {{inviter}} invited you to help run {{org}} as an admin on Tournament Leaderboard. Sign in with the Google account for {{email}}: {{link}} (code {{code}}). Valid until {{date}}, and only once.
adminMembers.revoked: The invite for {{email}} no longer works.
adminMembers.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from the organisation? Their player and scores stay.
adminMembers.ownershipHelp: The owner can hand ownership to another admin, and stays an admin. There's always exactly one owner, who can't be removed or made a player.
adminMembers.transferConfirm: Make {{name}} the owner? You stay an admin.
adminMembers.noOtherAdmin: Invite another admin first: ownership can only go to an admin.
adminMembers.ownerOnly: Only the owner can hand ownership on.
adminMembers.invalid: That was refused. Check the email and try again.
adminMembers.conflict: That isn't possible: they may already be an admin, or be the owner.
adminMembers.failed: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.

join.typeHelp: An admin sent you a code like K7QM-4FXP. Type it to see the invitation.
join.unknownBody: Check it was typed exactly as sent, or ask the admin for a new one.
join.tooManyBody: Wait a minute, then try again.
join.invited: {{inviter}} invited {{email}} to help run {{org}}. Sign in with the Google account for that address to accept.
join.wrongAccount: This invite is for {{email}}, and you’re signed in as {{me}}. Sign in with the invited Google account, or ask for an invite for this one.
join.failed: That didn’t work. The invite may have just expired or been used.
join.acceptedBody: You can now enter scores, manage players, seasons, scoring and members.
join.expiredBody: It was only valid for the time its admin chose. Ask an admin of {{org}} for a new one.
join.usedBody: An invite works only once. Ask an admin of {{org}} for a new one.
join.revokedBody: An admin of {{org}} stopped it. Ask them for a new one.
join.separate: Each organisation keeps its own players, scores and admins. Being an admin here gives you no access to any other organisation.
